items.title: Add file-based item tracking
items.description: Move from one-off batch manifests toward an ongoing, file-based tracking system for items: what is listed, where, for how long, and what it sells for vs list price. Keep existing batch/manifest and .signals flow intact; add a new inventory record structure for new items going forward.

items.title: Add inventory reporting and optional .signals sync
items.description: Add simple, file-based reports (e.g., listed items, stale listings, price deltas) and optionally sync key fields between inventory listing records and existing batch .signals files when a batch item is promoted into inventory.

items.title: Add optional schema validation for inventory YAML
items.description: Add lightweight schema validation (JSON Schema or simple script) for `inventory/items/*/item.yaml` and `inventory/items/*/listings.yaml` to prevent drift once volume increases.
